notes: #1’s plate is inscribed MDXCVII (1597); #2–#4 are uncolored copies of the same plate (#3 a book spread with the gutter through it). #5 is small (1500 px) and schematic, with invented mountains behind the town, but it is labeled and keyed; drop it if too weak. #6/#7 (Karácson series, dated only ‘18th century’) repeat the Peeters composition, so skipped. #9 and #11 (1950) are the same view from the town hall tower; neither shows the cathedral hill. #10 (1955, the Rába with the Carmelite church) is an alternative for P5.
